title: Godot Open MCP skill client-paths manifest
description: Single source of truth for project-relative agent-skill install paths and the MCP-client to skill-target mapping. The JSON Schema enforces structural shape only (every client has a relativePath, every mcpClientMapping value is a string array). Cross-field rules — every MCP-client id in mcpClientMapping matches the CLI agent registry, every mapping value names a key in clients, no duplicate relativePath, and templateRelativePath exists — are enforced by scripts/check-skill.mjs because they require reading the CLI registry and the filesystem.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference. Self-referential in the shipped manifest.

skillId.description: Stable skill identifier used by clients to namespace the skill directory (e.g. 'godot-open-mcp').

templateRelativePath.description: Path of the template SKILL.md relative to the repository root. Must exist (enforced by scripts/check-skill.mjs).

description.description: Free-form note for maintainers (not consumed by tooling).

clients.description: Map of client key to project-relative install metadata. Keys are the canonical skill-target identifiers used by mcpClientMapping. Paths are relative, forward-slash, and stay inside the target project (no parent traversal).

relativePath.description: Project-relative path the skill template is copied to (forward slashes; no leading slash; no '..' segments).

mcpClientMapping.description: Map of MCP-client id (mirrors the cli/src/utils/agents.ts agentRegistry vocabulary) to one or more client keys from `clients`. An explicit empty array means this MCP client has no supported skill install target today. Cross-field constraints (every key is a registered CLI agent id; every array element is a key in clients) are enforced by scripts/check-skill.mjs.
